info.title: Ryu Sites management API
info.summary: Create, version, deploy and manage Sites on a standalone Sites process's management listener.
info.description: Ryu Sites is early access and self-hosted only, and standalone mode needs a ryu-sites release after 0.4.0, which is not published yet. The published 0.4.0 runs only as the Core-managed sidecar; with a later release you run the standalone process yourself, and there is no Ryu-hosted offer. This document covers the management listener (`RYU_SITES_PORT`; the Sites docs start it on `http://127.0.0.1:8021`), whose `/api/sites/*` routes take the standalone management bearer. Deployed pages, their `/_ryu/*` data routes and each Site's MCP endpoint are on the separate visitor listener and are not in this document. Every change sends the `revision` it read as `expectedRevision`; a stale one answers `409 conflict`. A new Site is private, and deploying it does not change that: to serve it to everyone, the operator sets `RYU_SITES_PUBLIC=1` and you set `settings.audience` to `public` with `PUT /api/sites/projects/{id}/settings`. Errors are `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`, or RFC 9457 problem details when Accept names `application/problem+json`; every response carries `X-Request-ID`, except the listener's empty 413 for a body over 2,200,000 bytes.

put.description: Owner only. Replaces every setting at once: send the Site's current `settings` with your changes and the `revision` you read as `expectedRevision` (the SDK's `projects.updateSettings()` does this for you). `database` and `extensions` have their own routes and must be sent unchanged (`400 database_managed_separately` / `extensions_managed_separately`). `audience: "public"` answers `403 policy_denied` unless the operator allows public Sites (`RYU_SITES_PUBLIC=1`, or the runtime config's `publicEnabled` when that variable is unset; `GET /api/sites/status` reports `publicEnabled`). A non-null `workspaceId` must be a workspace the caller belongs to (`403 forbidden`); the standalone management caller belongs to none. Sharing, sign-in, shared data, AI and owner reset checks need services the process may not have connected, and answer `503 unavailable` without them. Emails are stored lower-cased.

Bearer.description: The standalone management bearer (`RYU_SITES_API_TOKEN` on the service; `RYU_SITES_API_KEY` for `@ryuhq/services`).

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above the route's cap are clamped to it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retried write safe (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header/). A Structured Field String (`"<key>"`) of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters; a bare token is also accepted. Keys are scoped to the presented credential (the `Authorization` header, or `x-api-key` when no `Authorization` is sent), method and path, and expire after 24 hours. A request is the same when its query string, `Content-Type` and body match. A repeat of the same request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different request answers 422; a repeat while the first request is in flight answers 409. Only 2xx, 400, 404, 409 and 422 outcomes are stored.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Makes a retried write safe (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header/). A Structured Field String (`"<key>"`) of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters; a bare token is also accepted. Keys are scoped to the presented credential (the `Authorization` header, or `x-api-key` when no `Authorization` is sent), method and path, and expire after 24 hours. A request is the same when its query string, `Content-Type` and body match. A repeat of the same request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different request answers 422; a repeat while the first request is in flight answers 409. Only 2xx, 400, 404, 409 and 422 outcomes are stored.

VersionIdQuery.name: versionId
VersionIdQuery.description: The saved version to scan; the latest by default.

RateLimit.description: Remaining quota for the policy in effect, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";r=0;t=30`). Sent by the limiters that expose a remaining count; the per-key API limiter does not yet, so a 429 here may carry no rate-limit fields.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The quota policy, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";q=100;w=60`).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 §10.2.3), when the server knows it.

Deprecation.description: Present only on a deprecated route: when it was or will be deprecated, as an RFC 9745 Structured Field Date (`@<unix seconds>`). No route is deprecated today.

Sunset.description: Present only on a deprecated route with a removal date: the HTTP-date after which it may stop responding (RFC 8594).

Link.description: On a deprecated route, `rel="deprecation"` links the versioning and deprecation policy (RFC 9745 §3) and `rel="successor-version"` the replacement.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay stored for the request's `Idempotency-Key`.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Bearer challenge (RFC 6750) naming the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728 `resource_metadata`).

SitesWWWAuthenticate.description: The management listener's RFC 6750 challenge: `Bearer realm="ryu-sites"`, with `error="invalid_token"` added when a bearer token was sent and rejected. Sites publishes no resource metadata.

RequestId.description: The server-generated request id (`req_<32 hex>`), on every management response. Quote it when you report a problem.

limits.description: This runtime's limits, by name, such as `projects`, `versions`, `totalArtifactBytes`, `records`, `files`, `fileBytes` and their per-visitor shares. Names ending in `Bytes` are sizes in bytes; names ending in `Percent` are percentages; names ending in `PerMinute` or `PerDay` are rates per minute or per UTC day, and `connectionCallsPerVisitor` is also per UTC day. Other names are counts. Read the values here rather than hard-coding them.

mode.description: `standalone`: the Sites service runs on its own. `core`: it runs as a Ryu Core app sidecar.

publicEnabled.description: Whether the operator allows the public audience (`RYU_SITES_PUBLIC=1`, or the runtime config's `publicEnabled` when that variable is unset).

visitorPort.description: The port the visitor listener serves Sites on; a `localhost` base domain serves `http://<slug>.localhost:<visitorPort>/`.

baseDomain.description: The visitor domain suffix; a Site answers at `<slug>.<baseDomain>`.

additionalProperties.description: `<service>Available` flags for this process's optional services.

script.description: The visitor runtime script, or an empty string when none is bundled.

bytes.description: The saved HTML's size in bytes.

message.description: The note saved with the version.

commit.description: The git commit SHA recorded with the version, or null.

extensions.description: The Site tools saved with the version (the Site's `extensions` setting when it was saved). Absent on versions saved before Site tools existed.

SiteExtensions.description: The Site tools saved with a version. A stored version carries every field or none.

mcp.description: Whether the Site serves an MCP server.

ui.description: Whether the Site's MCP server offers the Site as a UI view.

connections.description: Owner connector binding ids the Site may call.

description.description: What the tool does, as agents see it.

collection.description: Which records collection the tool works on. Default `data`.

SiteDomainBinding.description: One custom domain bound to a Site.

verification.description: The DNS verification value to publish for the host.

checkedAt.description: When the binding was last checked, or null before the first check.

label.description: The binding's name, as visitors see it.

description.description: What the binding is for, as visitors see it.

revision.description: Increases with every material change; a new revision asks visitors to consent again.

SiteRemixSource.description: The Site and version a Site was remixed or duplicated from.

Project.description: A Site. Send `revision` back as `expectedRevision` with the next change.

schemaVersion.description: The stored record's format version; always 1.

audience.description: Who may open the Site. New Sites are `private`.

settings.description: The Site's settings. Owner-only settings, such as the AI instructions, are blank for editors and viewers.

domains.description: Custom domain bindings: each `host`, its `status` (`pending_dns`, `pending_tls`, `active` or `failed`), its DNS `verification` value and when it was last checked.

aliases.description: Earlier URL names that redirect here.

connections.description: Owner-managed connector bindings visitors may use.

access.description: What the caller may do with the Site: `owner`, `editor` or `viewer`.

remixedFrom.description: The Site and version this one was remixed or duplicated from. Sites sets it only on a remix or duplicate; on any other Site the key is absent.

template.description: The template the Site started from.

deploymentId.description: The deployed version a remix copies.

access.description: Whether the caller may edit the Site or only view it.

ProjectList.description: Full Sites for `owned` and `shared`; gallery cards for `remixable`.

slug.description: URL name: 5-48 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

prompt.description: What the Site is for, stored as the Site brief.

URL name: 5-48 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

expectedRevision.description: Pins the source revision you reviewed.

expectedRevision.description: The `revision` you last read. A stale value answers `409 conflict`.

status.description: `passed`: no known secret pattern found, so the version may be deployed. `blocked`: a potential secret was found. `unavailable`: the scanner could not run; deployment is blocked.

detail.description: What the protection does, for a person.

protections.description: The runtime protections that apply to every Site, by `name` and `detail`.

limitation.description: What the check does not cover.

Settings.description: Every setting of a Site (the satellite's `siteSettings`). A field left out takes its default, so send them all.

mode.description: The data runtime: `local`, or `connected` to Ryu.

audience.description: Who may open the Site. `public` needs the operator to allow public Sites (`publicEnabled` in the status).

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose members may visit, for `workspace`; one you belong to.

agentActions.description: Owner reset checks; only for the `reset-calendar` starter.

aiDailyLimit.description: AI calls the Site may make per day.

aiMode.description: `grounded` answers only from the bound Space; `general` also lets the page call the model.

aiAnonymous.description: General AI calls without visitor sign-in.

aiSystemPrompt.description: Owner instructions; returned empty to editors and viewers.

storage.description: Durable records; needs a connected database.

spaceId.description: The knowledge Space grounded AI answers from.

database.description: Managed by the database routes; send it unchanged.

sharedData.description: Records every permitted visitor reads together; needs a database and the connected runtime.

extensions.description: Managed by the extensions routes; send it unchanged.

allowRemix.description: Lets anyone who may visit start a private copy of the deployed version.

expectedRevision.description: The `revision` you last read. A stale value answers `409 conflict`.

slug.description: URL name: 5-48 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

SitesError.description: Every Sites error carries this `error` member. It is the whole body unless the request's Accept names `application/problem+json`; the problem form adds the `SitesProblem` members. `invalid_input` from a schema check also lists the rejected `fields`.

error.description: The error's `code`, `message` and, for some codes, `fields`.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

fields.description: `invalid_input` from a schema check: the rejected fields.

SitesProblem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, sent only when the request's Accept names `application/problem+json`: the standard members, the `code`, and the same `error` member as the legacy `SitesError` body.

type.description: The problem type, the same for every code: `https://docs.ryuhq.com/docs/standalone/sites-api#revisions-and-errors`, the section that documents the codes. Use `code` to tell codes apart.

docs.description: The documentation of the Sites error codes; equals `type`.

requestId.description: The same value as the `X-Request-ID` header.

error.description: The same `error` member as the legacy `SitesError` body.
